clean_description: In "Red Harvest," a nameless detective arrives in the corrupt town of Personville to clean up the rampant crime and moral decay. The narrative unfolds as he navigates the treacherous landscape of betrayal and violence, employing ruthless tactics to confront the city's criminal elements. Hammett's work is characterized by its gritty realism and sharp dialogue, reflecting the chaotic atmosphere of Prohibition-era America.
